answer: A defense ties every reward to per-identity work that can't be shared. Each agent receives a unique seed — a private cipher only its own key unlocks — and must return original reasoning to that seed; copying a peer's answer fails verification. A violet haze of fake identities earns nothing, because each must independently do real cognitive work, while the epoch emission is capped and split among all claimants. The economics read like a blunt fable: effort grows linearly with every identity you forge, yet the spoils do not.
